manage the care of my vulnerable 92 year old mother. The carer dropped a urine sample at the acute hub at 9 am this morning as mum has been more confused and fallen so a uti suspected.
I called at 10, 12 and 2.30 and was told nurse had been in clinic and hadn’t tested the sample but a GP would call later.
At 5.35 Dr Ogundiya called and said they couldn’t find the urine sample: no apology or awareness of how poor this is and unacceptable for a vulnerable patient .
We have wasted all day and this practice has shown no care or understanding.
There is a serious problem with their processes if they lose a sample from one of two buildings.
Very poor and unacceptable

New review 17.02.26
Attached photo was sent to this practice 16:2/26 after my 92 year old mother had fallen again in the kitchen.
A home visit was agreed for 17/2/26: no one came.
I called at 4 pm and was told the District Nurse was coming 18/2/26 and to call them . On calling I found that they do not answer calls after 4 pm!
I am at a loss for words at the poor care of an elderly person who lives alone with carers coming in.
The wound could easily become infected. We did call 111 who couldn’t come out until 10.30/11 pm by which time mum was fast asleep .
Not wise to be elderly and ill in Ventnor!",null,[0,186]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WbmFVdFZjMGN5WDA1NU9XUmphVTFuZFdSVFNWRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x15540b64b0e40e59!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmVnaUtVc0cyX055OWRjaU1ndWRTSVE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21WbmFVdFZjMGN5WDA1NU9XUmphVTFuZFdSVFNWRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwieqKahgLOTAxXwDmMBHZ-xBQcQoykIBigC"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwieqKahgLOTAxXwDmMBHZ-xBQcQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDlVV0haNFNGOWZSV2hEVTA1VFYwUkNhMUkxZEZnM1ZrOTVUVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpUUVVOWk5VNWxYMFZqV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSemFrNDNkM2d5Wkd0Sk0weEJOVjh6YVVFd1ExRRAB",["0x0:0x15540b64b0e40e59",null,1759225541566885,1759225541566885,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/104739697624385654511/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Ben Furniss","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLZbMVmn18TwptTwqoCHoJ2xa5giFntFywr-oLYXQMnfLcZbA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/104739697624385654511?hl=en"],"104739697624385654511",null,7,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["7 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwieqKahgLOTAxXwDmMBHZ-xBQcQ7LoGCAgoAA"]]]],null,"5 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I spoke to a receptionist called Melissa.
